author: A. B. Gillette
title: Bryan Steil calls for no congressional pay during shutdowns and addresses insider trading
text:
Bryan Steil, U.S. Congressman representing Wisconsin’s 1st district since 2019, addressed congressional pay and government shutdowns in a series of posts on March 24, 2026.
In his first post of the day, Steil called for lawmakers to forgo their pay during government shutdowns. He wrote: “EXACTLY @SenJohnKennedy – No pay for lawmakers when federal employees like TSA are forced to work without pay! PASS THE NO PAY DURING SHUTDOWNS ACT.” (March 24, 2026).
Later that afternoon, Steil outlined his legislative priorities regarding funding and congressional compensation during shutdowns. He stated: ” Fund DHS Pay TSA Stop members of Congress from being paid during shutdowns” (March 24, 2026).
In a subsequent post the same day, Steil addressed concerns about ethical conduct among legislators. He wrote: “Members of Congress should not profit off insider information” (March 24, 2026).
Steil has held his seat in Wisconsin’s 1st district since replacing Paul Ryan in 2019. He has secured reelection multiple times: defeating Randy Bryce in 2018, Roger Polack in 2020, Ann Roe in 2022, and Peter Barca in 2024.
